title: Minimum Flips to Make a OR b Equal to c

story.title: Three Lamp Rows
story.text: Lamp rows a and b are OR-ed to light row c. Going lamp by lamp from the right: if c wants it off, every lit lamp in a and b must flip; if c wants it on and both are off, flip one.
story.goal: Return the fewest bit flips in a and b so that a OR b == c.
